content:
We have a new stable release of Lean v4.31.0.

Please see the release notes for v4.31.0 for full details.

As usual Mathlib, doc-gen4, verso, Batteries, Aesop, Cslib, and the REPL are available using these toolchains via the v4.31.0 tag at the respective repositories (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.103).

We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.31.0 when possible (and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating). (Recall that you can use the lean-update github action to help automate this process.)
(Apologies that the v4.30.0 announcement never happened, but it's available too!)
The release notes and docstrings talk about a @[builtin_nolint], but I wasn't able to find any implementation in the source code. Am I bad at looking, or is this information outdated?
(see also #lean4 > Core support for environment linters @ 💬 , which suggested this attribute was not going to land)
builtin_lint is not shipped in a current nightly. 4.31.0 was cut before the option based approach to environment linters was merged, and hence the confusion in the release notes.
